output.sql:
SELECT COUNT(p.payment_id) AS late_payments
FROM marts.fct_payments AS p
JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = p.order_id
WHERE p.method = 'invoice'
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND p.paid_at - o.order_date > 30
output.explanation: Counts payments with method 'invoice' on orders placed in 2025 where the payment date is more than 30 days after the order date (day 31 or later). It counts payments, not orders, so an order with several late payments counts each one. No order status or revenue filter is applied, since the question doesn't ask for one. It assumes the invoice method is stored as the lowercase value 'invoice'.
